name: Downhill Attack & Contain
summary: Loosen up your handle, finish away from shot blockers, cut off drives with your feet, then push through tired-leg layups.

drills.name: Push-Pull Dribbles
drills.summary: Push the ball out in front, pull it back, and stay in control.
steps: Get in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the dribble forward one step, then pull it back to your hip.
Keep the ball moving for 30 seconds, then switch hands.
Add a crossover after every pull-back.
Finish with 30 seconds of push-pull while walking forward.

drills.name: Glass-Side Extension Finishes
drills.summary: Finish with the hand away from the shot blocker and use the glass.
steps: Start at the right wing with the ball.
Drive to the rim and pick up the ball off one dribble.
Reach out wide with your right hand and kiss it high off the glass.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left side and left hand.
Keep switching sides until time is up.

drills.name: Cone Cut-Off Slides
drills.summary: Beat the driver to the spot by sliding hard to a cone.
steps: Set two cones about 4 big steps apart.
Start in stance halfway between them.
Pick a cone and slide hard to it, chest square, without crossing your feet.
Plant your outside foot past the cone and stop in balance.
Slide back to the middle and go the other way. Rest 15 seconds every 45 seconds.

drills.name: Ladder Layup Sprints
drills.summary: Sprint to a line and back, then finish a layup while you're tired.
steps: Start under the hoop with the ball.
Speed dribble to the free throw line and back, then make a layup.
Speed dribble to half court and back, then make a layup.
Speed dribble to the far free throw line and back, then make a layup.
Rest 30 seconds, then start the ladder again until time is up.
